The '''AZ-322 Peacemaker''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. It was stationed at [[Wardpost Luurdes]] in [[King's Pass]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
